h1: DVA Lawn Care & Gardening Services Canberra for Veterans
title: DVA Gardening Services Canberra | Down the Rabbit Hole
description: DVA gardening services in Canberra from a registered DVA provider. Regular mowing and garden upkeep for Gold and White Card holders. Get a free quote today.
lede: Regular mowing, garden upkeep and tidy visits for DVA card holders and Defence families across Canberra and Queanbeyan.
intro: Down the Rabbit Hole AUST provides DVA gardening services in Canberra for veterans, DVA Gold and White Card holders and their families. We take care of regular mowing, garden upkeep and tidy visits so the yard stays in order without anyone in the household having to chase it. Down the Rabbit Hole AUST is a registered DVA provider, owned and run by Michael Robinson, so you deal directly with the owner. It is fully insured, ABN registered and locally operated, and has maintained 60+ Canberra lawns.

One thing first. Being a registered DVA provider means we can carry out DVA-funded work, but eligibility and approvals for lawn and garden help sit with the Department of Veterans' Affairs, not with us. We do not decide what is covered and we do not promise coverage. If you are unsure of your entitlement, confirm it with DVA before you book. Once that is settled, we give you a free upfront quote for the DVA gardening services you have in mind.

sections.h2: What our veteran garden care includes
paras: Most of our DVA gardening services are built around a regular visit: mowing, edging and a general tidy, with garden work added as needed. Green waste removal is available with every visit, so nothing needs to be left in a pile for you to deal with.
If you need something outside this list, ask and we will tell you plainly whether we do it.
bullets: Regular lawn mowing with edges and paths trimmed
Garden bed weeding, pruning and general upkeep
Hedge and shrub trimming to keep access clear
Leaf collection and seasonal tidy visits
Registered DVA provider for DVA-funded work
Small clean-ups when a yard has got away from you

sections.h2: How the visits work and what to expect
paras: It starts with a call or email. We ask about the yard, the card you hold and what you would like done, then quote before any work starts. As a registered DVA provider, we can supply the quote and paperwork DVA needs for the job. We cannot tell you whether the request will be approved, because that decision is not ours.

Because this is a small, owner-operated business, you are not explaining the yard to someone new every fortnight. Let us know about gates, pets or access when you book. If you are not home, that is fine, as long as we can reach the yard.
Reliable scheduling matters most to people who depend on DVA gardening services, so regular visits are booked on a schedule that suits you, within our weekday hours.

sections.h2: Canberra seasons and a year-round schedule
paras: Kikuyu, couch and buffalo lawns slow right down through the hard frosts from May to August, then surge from September. Summers are hot and dry, so mowing height matters and we keep water restrictions in mind. Autumn brings leaf drop from deciduous street trees, often the busiest tidy-up season.

For most yards on DVA gardening services, that means fortnightly mowing through spring and summer, monthly visits through winter and an extra tidy in autumn. We adjust the schedule to your yard rather than running one plan for everyone.

sections.h2: Where we work for DVA card holders
paras: We offer DVA lawn care Canberra wide, with Weston Creek our priority area, plus Woden Valley, Tuggeranong, Belconnen, the Inner North and Inner South, and across the border in Queanbeyan and Jerrabomberra. Suburbs we cover include Kambah, Wanniassa and Kaleen.
Residential and commercial work are both welcome, so DVA gardening services can extend to a veterans' group or community facility that needs its grounds kept tidy.

faqs.q: Will DVA pay for my lawn mowing?
faqs.a: We cannot tell you that, and we will not guess. Approvals sit with the Department of Veterans' Affairs. As a registered DVA provider, we can give you a free, upfront quote for the work. If your request is approved, we get started.

faqs.q: Do you provide DVA gardening services to White Card holders as well as Gold Card holders?
faqs.a: We provide the service to any veteran or family member who asks. Whether DVA supports the cost depends on your card, your circumstances and DVA's own rules, which we cannot assess. Confirm your entitlement with DVA or your provider first, then call us for a quote.

faqs.q: Can my son or daughter organise the visits on my behalf?
faqs.a: Yes. DVA gardening services can be arranged by a family member who lives elsewhere in Canberra or interstate. They can book, receive the quote and handle the scheduling by phone or email, so the household does not have to.

faqs.q: Are you a registered DVA provider?
faqs.a: Yes. Down the Rabbit Hole AUST is a registered DVA provider for lawn and garden care in Canberra and Queanbeyan. DVA still decides who is eligible and what it will fund, so confirm your entitlement with DVA before you book.

faqs.q: Will I be dealing with someone different each time?
faqs.a: No. Down the Rabbit Hole AUST is a small, owner-operated business, so you are not dealing with a rotating roster of strangers. That makes DVA gardening services easier to trust. Tell us about the gate, the dog or anything else about the yard when you book.

faqs.q: Do you take the green waste away after a DVA garden visit in Tuggeranong?
faqs.a: Yes. Green waste removal is available with every mowing, garden maintenance and clean-up job, whether you are in Tuggeranong, Belconnen or Queanbeyan. Nothing needs to be left on the nature strip for you to deal with later.
